struct CheckFailure: Error, CustomStringConvertible { let description: String }
func expect(_ condition: @autoclosure () -> Bool, _ message: String) throws {
    if !condition() { throw CheckFailure(description: message) }
}
func refuses(_ reason: InspectionFailure, _ action: () throws -> Void) throws {
    do { try action() } catch let error as InspectionFailure {
        try expect(error == reason, "Expected \(reason.rawValue), received \(error.rawValue)")
        return
    }
    throw CheckFailure(description: "Expected refusal: \(reason.rawValue)")
}
func plist(_ value: [String: Any]) throws -> Data {
    try PropertyListSerialization.data(fromPropertyList: value, format: .xml, options: 0)
}
func json(_ value: Any) throws -> Data { try JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: value, options: [.sortedKeys]) }
func object(_ data: Data) throws -> [String: Any] {
    guard let result = try JSONSerialization.jsonObject(with: data) as? [String: Any] else {
        throw CheckFailure(description: "Invalid test JSON object")
    }
    return result
}
let old = FirefoxTargets.pins[0]
let appPath = "/fixture/private/mount/Firefox.app"
let dmgPath = "/fixture/private/Firefox.dmg"
func evidence(_ pin: TargetPin = FirefoxTargets.pins[0]) throws -> AppEvidence {
    let commands: [String: CommandResult] = [
        "imageVerify": .init(executable: "/usr/bin/hdiutil", arguments: ["verify", dmgPath], stdout: "verified CRC32 $FIXTURE\n"),
        "signature": .init(executable: "/usr/bin/codesign", arguments: ["--verify", "--deep", "--strict", appPath]),
        "identity": .init(executable: "/usr/bin/codesign", arguments: ["-dv", "--verbose=4", appPath],
            stderr: "Identifier=org.mozilla.firefox\nAuthority=Developer ID Application: Mozilla Corporation (43AQ936H96)\nTeamIdentifier=43AQ936H96\n"),
        "architectures": .init(executable: "/usr/bin/lipo", arguments: ["-archs", appPath + "/Contents/MacOS/firefox"], stdout: "x86_64 arm64\n"),
        "gatekeeper": .init(executable: "/usr/sbin/spctl", arguments: ["--assess", "--type", "execute", "--verbose=4", appPath],
            stderr: appPath + ": accepted\nsource=Notarized Developer ID\n"),
        "ticket": .init(executable: "/usr/bin/xcrun", arguments: ["stapler", "validate", appPath], stdout: "The validate action worked!\n"),
        "containerSignature": .init(executable: "/usr/bin/codesign", arguments: ["--verify", "--deep", "--strict", dmgPath], exitCode: 1, stderr: "code object is not signed at all\n"),
        "containerGatekeeper": .init(executable: "/usr/sbin/spctl", arguments: ["--assess", "--type", "open", "--context", "context:primary-signature", "--verbose=4", dmgPath], exitCode: 3, stderr: "rejected\nsource=no usable signature\n"),
        "containerTicket": .init(executable: "/usr/bin/xcrun", arguments: ["stapler", "validate", dmgPath], exitCode: 65, stdout: "does not have a ticket stapled to it\n")
    ]
    return AppEvidence(appPath: appPath, dmgPath: dmgPath,
        infoPlist: try plist(["CFBundleIdentifier": pin.bundleID, "CFBundleShortVersionString": pin.version,
                              "CFBundleExecutable": "firefox", "CFBundlePackageType": "APPL"]), commands: commands)
}
func withWorkspace(_ body: (URL) throws -> Void) throws {
    // Resolve the platform's /var alias once for fixture creation only. Production
    // APIs must still reject explicitly supplied symlinks, including ancestors.
    guard let physical = realpath(FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.path, nil) else {
        throw CheckFailure(description: "Cannot resolve temporary fixture base")
    }
    defer { free(physical) }
    let root = URL(fileURLWithPath: String(cString: physical)).appendingPathComponent("artifact-checks-\(UUID().uuidString)")
    try FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: root, withIntermediateDirectories: false,
                                           attributes: [.posixPermissions: 0o700])
    defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: root) }
    try body(root)
}
func attachment(_ paths: [String]) throws -> Data {
    try plist(["system-entities": paths.enumerated().map { index, path in
        ["dev-entry": "/dev/disk999s\(index + 1)", "mount-point": path, "volume-kind": "hfs"]
    }])
}
final class MountRunner: InspectionCommandRunning {
    var calls: [CommandResult] = []
    var attachExit: Int32 = 0
    var detachExit: Int32 = 0
    var foreignMount = false
    func run(executable: String, arguments: [String], limits: InspectionLimits) throws -> CommandResult {
        let result: CommandResult
        if arguments.first == "attach" {
            guard let index = arguments.firstIndex(of: "-mountpoint"), index + 1 < arguments.count else {
                throw CheckFailure(description: "Attach lacks explicit owned mountpoint")
            }
            let path = foreignMount ? "/Volumes/Unrelated" : arguments[index + 1]
            result = .init(executable: executable, arguments: arguments, exitCode: attachExit,
                           stdout: String(decoding: try attachment([path]), as: UTF8.self))
        } else {
            result = .init(executable: executable, arguments: arguments,
                           exitCode: arguments.first == "detach" ? detachExit : 0)
        }
        calls.append(result)
        return result
    }
}

var cases: [(String, () throws -> Void)] = []
@MainActor func check(_ name: String, _ action: @escaping () throws -> Void) { cases.append((name, action)) }

if Array(CommandLine.arguments.dropFirst()) == ["--size-policy"] {
    addSizePolicyChecks()
    var failures = 0
    for (name, action) in cases {
        do { try action(); print("PASS fixture: \(name)") }
        catch { failures += 1; print("FAIL fixture: \(name): \(error)") }
    }
    print("PAT-2709 artifact size: \(cases.count) cases, \(failures) failures")
    exit(failures == 0 ? 0 : 1)
}
addSizePolicyChecks()

for pin in FirefoxTargets.pins {
    check("exact target \(pin.version)") {
        let found = try FirefoxTargets.select(version: pin.version)
        try expect(found == pin, "Target must match every reviewed pin")
    }
    check("official HTTPS URL \(pin.version)") {
        try DownloadPolicy.validate(hops: [pin.url], pin: pin, receivedBytes: pin.byteLength, elapsedSeconds: 10)
    }
    check("payload passes separately from unsigned DMG \(pin.version)") {
        let result = try EvidenceEvaluator.evaluateFixture(evidence(pin), pin: pin)
        try expect(result.appChecksPassed, "Valid app fixture must pass")
        try expect(!result.containerSignaturePassed && !result.containerGatekeeperPassed && !result.containerTicketPassed,
                   "Unsigned-container failures must remain separate")
        try expect(result.origin == .fixture && !result.freshOSValidation && !result.installationAuthorized,
                   "Fixtures cannot grant fresh OS or installation authority")
    }
}
for version in ["latest", "157", "0157.0", "157.0.0", "157.0beta", "158.0", "157.0\n"] {
    check("unknown target \(String(reflecting: version))") {
        try refuses(.unknownTarget) { _ = try FirefoxTargets.select(version: version) }
    }
}
let unsafeURLs = [
    old.url.replacingOccurrences(of: "https:", with: "http:"),
    old.url.replacingOccurrences(of: "archive.mozilla.org", with: "archive.mozilla.org.evil.example"),
    old.url.replacingOccurrences(of: "archive.mozilla.org", with: "evil.example@archive.mozilla.org"),
    old.url.replacingOccurrences(of: "archive.mozilla.org", with: "archive.mozilla.org:443"),
    old.url.replacingOccurrences(of: "archive.mozilla.org", with: "archive.mozilla.org."),
    old.url.replacingOccurrences(of: "/mac/", with: "/../mac/"),
    old.url.replacingOccurrences(of: "/mac/", with: "/%2e%2e/mac/"),
    old.url.replacingOccurrences(of: "/mac/", with: "/%252e%252e/mac/"),
    old.url.replacingOccurrences(of: "/mac/", with: "/%2fmac/"),
    old.url.replacingOccurrences(of: "/mac/", with: "//mac/"),
    old.url + "?download=1", old.url + "#trusted", old.url + "\n", "file:///etc/hosts", "//archive.mozilla.org/file.dmg",
    old.url.replacingOccurrences(of: "/mac/", with: "\\mac/")
]
for (index, url) in unsafeURLs.enumerated() {
    check("unsafe initial URL \(index)") {
        try refuses(.unsafeURL) { try DownloadPolicy.validate(hops: [url], pin: old, receivedBytes: 0, elapsedSeconds: 0) }
    }
    check("unsafe redirect \(index)") {
        try refuses(.unsafeURL) { try DownloadPolicy.validate(hops: [old.url, url], pin: old, receivedBytes: 0, elapsedSeconds: 0) }
    }
}
check("same-host safe redirect remains bounded") {
    try DownloadPolicy.validate(hops: [old.url, old.url], pin: old, receivedBytes: old.byteLength, elapsedSeconds: 1)
}
check("wrong initial official release") {
    try refuses(.unsafeURL) { try DownloadPolicy.validate(hops: [FirefoxTargets.pins[1].url], pin: old, receivedBytes: 0, elapsedSeconds: 0) }
}
check("missing URL chain") {
    try refuses(.unsafeURL) { try DownloadPolicy.validate(hops: [], pin: old, receivedBytes: 0, elapsedSeconds: 0) }
}
check("redirect limit") {
    try refuses(.redirectLimit) { try DownloadPolicy.validate(hops: Array(repeating: old.url, count: 5), pin: old, receivedBytes: 0, elapsedSeconds: 0) }
}
for (name, bytes, seconds) in [("time", Int64(0), 181.0), ("bytes", Int64(170_000_001), 1.0),
                              ("pinned length overflow", old.byteLength + 1, 1.0), ("negative bytes", Int64(-1), 1.0),
                              ("negative time", Int64(0), -1.0), ("nonfinite time", Int64(0), Double.infinity)] {
    check("download bound \(name)") {
        try refuses(.downloadLimit) { try DownloadPolicy.validate(hops: [old.url], pin: old, receivedBytes: bytes, elapsedSeconds: seconds) }
    }
}

let abcDigest = "ba7816bf8f01cfea414140de5dae2223b00361a396177a9cb410ff61f20015ad"
func verifyABC(_ path: String) throws { try ArtifactBytes.verify(path: path, expectedSHA256: abcDigest, expectedLength: 3) }
check("exact local bytes read without mutation") {
    try withWorkspace { root in
        let path = root.appendingPathComponent("artifact.dmg")
        try Data("abc".utf8).write(to: path)
        try verifyABC(path.path)
        let after = try Data(contentsOf: path)
        try expect(after == Data("abc".utf8), "Inspection changed input")
    }
}
for (name, bytes, reason) in [("same-length tamper", "abd", InspectionFailure.digestMismatch),
                             ("truncation", "ab", .lengthMismatch), ("oversize", "abcd", .lengthMismatch)] {
    check("local bytes \(name)") {
        try withWorkspace { root in
            let path = root.appendingPathComponent("artifact.dmg")
            try Data(bytes.utf8).write(to: path)
            try refuses(reason) { try verifyABC(path.path) }
        }
    }
}
check("directory refused without blocking") {
    try withWorkspace { root in try refuses(.notRegularFile) { try verifyABC(root.path) } }
}
check("FIFO refused without blocking") {
    try withWorkspace { root in
        let path = root.appendingPathComponent("pipe").path
        try expect(mkfifo(path, 0o600) == 0, "Cannot create FIFO fixture")
        try refuses(.notRegularFile) { try verifyABC(path) }
    }
}
for ancestor in [false, true] {
    check(ancestor ? "ancestor symlink refused" : "final symlink refused") {
        try withWorkspace { root in
            let file = root.appendingPathComponent("real.dmg")
            let alias = root.appendingPathComponent("alias")
            try Data("abc".utf8).write(to: file)
            try FileManager.default.createSymbolicLink(at: alias, withDestinationURL: ancestor ? root : file)
            try refuses(.unsafePath) { try verifyABC(ancestor ? alias.appendingPathComponent("real.dmg").path : alias.path) }
        }
    }
}
for path in ["relative.dmg", "/tmp/../etc/hosts", "/tmp/./file.dmg", "/tmp//file.dmg", "/tmp/file\0.dmg"] {
    check("unsafe local path \(String(reflecting: path))") { try refuses(.unsafePath) { try verifyABC(path) } }
}
check("missing local input") {
    try withWorkspace { root in try refuses(.unsafePath) { try verifyABC(root.appendingPathComponent("absent").path) } }
}

func changedEvidence(_ change: (inout AppEvidence) throws -> Void) throws -> AppEvidence {
    var item = try evidence(); try change(&item); return item
}
@MainActor func rejectsEvidence(_ name: String, _ reason: InspectionFailure, _ change: @escaping (inout AppEvidence) throws -> Void) {
    check(name) { try refuses(reason) { _ = try EvidenceEvaluator.evaluateFixture(changedEvidence(change), pin: old) } }
}
for key in ["imageVerify", "signature", "identity", "architectures", "gatekeeper", "ticket", "containerSignature", "containerGatekeeper", "containerTicket"] {
    rejectsEvidence("missing command \(key)", .missingEvidence) { $0.commands.removeValue(forKey: key) }
}
for key in ["imageVerify", "signature", "identity", "architectures", "gatekeeper", "ticket"] {
    rejectsEvidence("nonzero exit despite good output \(key)", .commandFailed) { $0.commands[key]!.exitCode = 1 }
    rejectsEvidence("timeout despite zero exit \(key)", .commandTimedOut) { $0.commands[key]!.timedOut = true }
    rejectsEvidence("truncated output \(key)", .outputLimit) { $0.commands[key]!.outputExceeded = true }
}
rejectsEvidence("codesign wrong team", .wrongTeam) { $0.commands["identity"]!.stderr = "Identifier=org.mozilla.firefox\nTeamIdentifier=WRONGTEAM\n" }
rejectsEvidence("codesign missing team", .wrongTeam) { $0.commands["identity"]!.stderr = "Identifier=org.mozilla.firefox\n" }
rejectsEvidence("codesign conflicting teams", .wrongTeam) { $0.commands["identity"]!.stderr += "TeamIdentifier=WRONGTEAM\n" }
rejectsEvidence("codesign mismatched identity", .wrongBundle) { $0.commands["identity"]!.stderr = "Identifier=org.fake.firefox\nTeamIdentifier=43AQ936H96\n" }
rejectsEvidence("signature invocation omits deep strict", .invalidMetadata) { $0.commands["signature"]!.arguments = ["--verify", appPath] }
rejectsEvidence("signature invocation substitutes executable", .invalidMetadata) { $0.commands["signature"]!.executable = "/bin/true" }
rejectsEvidence("signature invocation targets another bundle", .invalidMetadata) { $0.commands["signature"]!.arguments[3] = "/Applications/Firefox.app" }
rejectsEvidence("gatekeeper invoked for container instead of app", .invalidMetadata) { $0.commands["gatekeeper"]!.arguments[2] = "open" }
for text in ["arm64\n", "x86_64\n", "arm64 x86_64 ppc\n", "arm64 arm64 x86_64\n", ""] {
    rejectsEvidence("architecture mismatch \(String(reflecting: text))", .wrongArchitecture) { $0.commands["architectures"]!.stdout = text }
}
for text in [appPath + ": rejected\nsource=Notarized Developer ID\n", appPath + ": accepted\nsource=Developer ID\n",
             "assessment unavailable\n", "not accepted\nsource=Notarized Developer ID\n",
             "/other.app: accepted\nsource=Notarized Developer ID\n", ""] {
    rejectsEvidence("notarisation refusal \(String(reflecting: text))", .notarizationRejected) { $0.commands["gatekeeper"]!.stderr = text }
}
rejectsEvidence("contradictory notarisation output", .notarizationRejected) { $0.commands["gatekeeper"]!.stderr += appPath + ": rejected\n" }
rejectsEvidence("stapler output unavailable despite zero", .ticketRejected) { $0.commands["ticket"]!.stdout = "Unable to validate ticket\n" }
for version in ["157.0.1", "0157.0", "157.0beta", "157.0\n", "", "157..0"] {
    rejectsEvidence("exact numeric dotted version \(String(reflecting: version))", .wrongVersion) {
        $0.infoPlist = try plist(["CFBundleIdentifier": old.bundleID, "CFBundleShortVersionString": version,
                                 "CFBundleExecutable": "firefox", "CFBundlePackageType": "APPL"])
    }
}
rejectsEvidence("wrong plist bundle", .wrongBundle) {
    $0.infoPlist = try plist(["CFBundleIdentifier": "org.fake.firefox", "CFBundleShortVersionString": old.version,
                             "CFBundleExecutable": "firefox", "CFBundlePackageType": "APPL"])
}
rejectsEvidence("malformed plist", .invalidMetadata) { $0.infoPlist = Data("not plist".utf8) }
rejectsEvidence("unsafe bundle executable", .invalidMetadata) {
    $0.infoPlist = try plist(["CFBundleIdentifier": old.bundleID, "CFBundleShortVersionString": old.version,
                             "CFBundleExecutable": "../../malicious", "CFBundlePackageType": "APPL"])
}
rejectsEvidence("missing OS build", .invalidMetadata) { $0.osBuild = "" }
rejectsEvidence("missing observation timestamp", .invalidMetadata) { $0.observedAt = "" }
rejectsEvidence("impossible command timestamp", .invalidMetadata) { $0.commands["signature"]!.finishedAt = "2026-10-06T14:35:33Z" }
check("replayed evidence never claims fresh OS checks") {
    let data = try JSONEncoder().encode(evidence())
    let result = try EvidenceEvaluator.replay(data, pin: old)
    try expect(result.appChecksPassed && result.origin == .replayed && !result.freshOSValidation && !result.installationAuthorized,
               "Replay must identify cached evidence and retain installation boundary")
}
check("self-asserted success without observations refused") {
    try refuses(.invalidRecord) {
        _ = try EvidenceEvaluator.replay(json(["appChecksPassed": true, "freshOSValidation": true,
                                               "installationAuthorized": true]), pin: old)
    }
}
check("replayed contradictory raw evidence refused") {
    var item = try evidence(); item.commands["signature"]!.exitCode = 1
    try refuses(.commandFailed) { _ = try EvidenceEvaluator.replay(JSONEncoder().encode(item), pin: old) }
}

let checkout = URL(fileURLWithPath: #filePath).deletingLastPathComponent().deletingLastPathComponent().deletingLastPathComponent()
let recordPath = checkout.appendingPathComponent("docs/firefox-artifact-evidence.json")
check("reviewed pinned record") {
    let result = try FirefoxTargets.verifyRecord(Data(contentsOf: recordPath))
    try expect(result == FirefoxTargets.pins, "Record must match both immutable targets")
}
for (name, mutate) in [
    ("wrong schema", { (doc: inout [String: Any]) in doc["schemaVersion"] = 2 }),
    ("self-asserted trust", { (doc: inout [String: Any]) in doc["verified"] = true }),
    ("missing pin", { (doc: inout [String: Any]) in doc["targets"] = [] }),
    ("duplicate pin", { (doc: inout [String: Any]) in
        let rows = doc["targets"] as! [[String: Any]]; doc["targets"] = [rows[0], rows[0]]
    }),
    ("changed digest", { (doc: inout [String: Any]) in
        var rows = doc["targets"] as! [[String: Any]]; rows[0]["sha256"] = String(repeating: "0", count: 64); doc["targets"] = rows
    }),
    ("changed URL", { (doc: inout [String: Any]) in
        var rows = doc["targets"] as! [[String: Any]]; rows[0]["url"] = "https://example.org/file.dmg"; doc["targets"] = rows
    }),
    ("changed byte length", { (doc: inout [String: Any]) in
        var rows = doc["targets"] as! [[String: Any]]; rows[0]["byteLength"] = 161304639; doc["targets"] = rows
    }),
    ("changed team", { (doc: inout [String: Any]) in
        var rows = doc["targets"] as! [[String: Any]]; rows[0]["teamID"] = "WRONG"; doc["targets"] = rows
    })
] {
    check("pinned record \(name)") {
        var doc = try object(Data(contentsOf: recordPath)); mutate(&doc)
        try refuses(.invalidRecord) { _ = try FirefoxTargets.verifyRecord(json(doc)) }
    }
}
for data in [Data("null".utf8), Data("{".utf8), Data("{\"schemaVersion\":1,\"schemaVersion\":2}".utf8)] {
    check("malformed or ambiguous pinned record \(String(decoding: data, as: UTF8.self))") {
        try refuses(.invalidRecord) { _ = try FirefoxTargets.verifyRecord(data) }
    }
}

check("mount plist identifies only owned mount") {
    let mount = "/private/fixture/mount"
    let result = try ReadOnlyMount.validateAttachment(attachment([mount]), ownedMountPath: mount)
    try expect(result == mount, "Return only the owned mount path")
}
for paths in [[], ["/Volumes/Unrelated"], ["/private/fixture/mount", "/Volumes/Unrelated"],
              ["/private/fixture/mount", "/private/fixture/mount"], ["/private/fixture/mount/../outside"]] {
    check("unexpected mount attachment \(paths)") {
        try refuses(.invalidMount) {
            _ = try ReadOnlyMount.validateAttachment(attachment(paths), ownedMountPath: "/private/fixture/mount")
        }
    }
}
check("malformed mount plist") {
    try refuses(.invalidMount) {
        _ = try ReadOnlyMount.validateAttachment(Data("not a plist".utf8), ownedMountPath: "/private/fixture/mount")
    }
}
for failure in [false, true] {
    check(failure ? "owned mount cleaned after payload refusal" : "owned mount cleaned after success") {
        try withWorkspace { root in
            let runner = MountRunner()
            var bodyCalled = false
            var usedMount: String?
            let operation = {
                _ = try ReadOnlyMount.withImage(dmgPath: dmgPath, workspace: root.path, runner: runner) { mount in
                    bodyCalled = true; usedMount = mount
                    try expect(mount.hasPrefix(root.path + "/"), "Mount must be private workspace child")
                    if failure { throw InspectionFailure.wrongTeam }
                    return "fixture inspected"
                }
            }
            if failure { try refuses(.wrongTeam, operation) } else { try operation() }
            try expect(bodyCalled, "Payload inspection was skipped")
            let attachments = runner.calls.filter { $0.arguments.first == "attach" }
            let detachments = runner.calls.filter { $0.arguments.first == "detach" }
            try expect(attachments.count == 1 && detachments.count == 1, "Attach/detach must be paired exactly once")
            try expect(attachments[0].executable == "/usr/bin/hdiutil", "Use the system image tool")
            try expect(attachments[0].arguments.contains("-readonly") && attachments[0].arguments.contains("-nobrowse") &&
                       attachments[0].arguments.contains("-plist"), "Attach must be readonly, nobrowse, plist")
            try expect(detachments[0].arguments == ["detach", usedMount!], "Detach only the exact owned mount path")
        }
    }
}
check("foreign mount never inspected or detached") {
    try withWorkspace { root in
        let runner = MountRunner(); runner.foreignMount = true
        var bodyCalled = false
        try refuses(.invalidMount) {
            _ = try ReadOnlyMount.withImage(dmgPath: dmgPath, workspace: root.path, runner: runner) { _ in bodyCalled = true }
        }
        try expect(!bodyCalled, "Foreign mount must never be inspected")
        try expect(!runner.calls.contains { $0.arguments.first == "detach" && $0.arguments.contains("/Volumes/Unrelated") },
                   "Foreign mount must never be detached")
    }
}
check("cleanup failure reported") {
    try withWorkspace { root in
        let runner = MountRunner(); runner.detachExit = 1
        try refuses(.cleanupFailed) {
            _ = try ReadOnlyMount.withImage(dmgPath: dmgPath, workspace: root.path, runner: runner) { _ in "ok" }
        }
    }
}
check("attach nonzero exit prevents payload use") {
    try withWorkspace { root in
        let runner = MountRunner(); runner.attachExit = 1
        var bodyCalled = false
        try refuses(.commandFailed) {
            _ = try ReadOnlyMount.withImage(dmgPath: dmgPath, workspace: root.path, runner: runner) { _ in bodyCalled = true }
        }
        try expect(!bodyCalled, "Nonzero attach must not execute payload callback")
    }
}
check("mount workspace symlink refused before command") {
    try withWorkspace { root in
        let alias = root.appendingPathComponent("alias")
        try FileManager.default.createSymbolicLink(at: alias, withDestinationURL: root)
        let runner = MountRunner()
        try refuses(.unsafePath) {
            _ = try ReadOnlyMount.withImage(dmgPath: dmgPath, workspace: alias.path, runner: runner) { _ in }
        }
        try expect(runner.calls.isEmpty, "Unsafe workspace must fail before command execution")
    }
}
check("world-writable workspace refused before command") {
    try withWorkspace { root in
        try FileManager.default.setAttributes([.posixPermissions: 0o777], ofItemAtPath: root.path)
        let runner = MountRunner()
        try refuses(.unsafePath) {
            _ = try ReadOnlyMount.withImage(dmgPath: dmgPath, workspace: root.path, runner: runner) { _ in }
        }
        try expect(runner.calls.isEmpty, "Non-private workspace must fail before command execution")
    }
}

check("real command exit and separate stdout stderr captured") {
    let result = try BoundedCommandRunner().run(executable: "/bin/sh",
        arguments: ["-c", "printf 'out\\n'; printf 'err\\n' >&2; exit 7"], limits: .init())
    try expect(result.exitCode == 7 && result.stdout == "out\n" && result.stderr == "err\n", "Actual exit and output must be retained")
    try expect(!result.timedOut && !result.outputExceeded && !result.startedAt.isEmpty && !result.finishedAt.isEmpty,
               "Retain timestamps and reliable completion state")
}
check("real command timeout terminates promptly") {
    var limits = InspectionLimits(); limits.commandSeconds = 0.1
    let started = Date()
    let result = try BoundedCommandRunner().run(executable: "/bin/sleep", arguments: ["10"], limits: limits)
    try expect(result.timedOut && result.exitCode != 0 && Date().timeIntervalSince(started) < 2, "Timed-out command must be stopped and reported")
}
check("real command output bound terminates both pipes") {
    var limits = InspectionLimits(); limits.outputBytes = 1024; limits.commandSeconds = 2
    let result = try BoundedCommandRunner().run(executable: "/bin/sh",
        arguments: ["-c", "while :; do printf '012345678901234567890123456789'; printf '012345678901234567890123456789' >&2; done"], limits: limits)
    try expect(result.outputExceeded && result.stdout.utf8.count + result.stderr.utf8.count <= 1024,
               "Combined output must be bounded and excess must be reported")
}

// CHECK-ADDED after parent authorisation: strengthen ambiguity and process limits.
addStrengtheningChecks()

var failures: [String] = []
for (name, body) in cases {
    do { try body() } catch { failures.append("\(name): \(error)") }
}
for failure in failures { print("FAIL \(failure)") }
print("Artifact acceptance: \(cases.count) cases; \(failures.count) failures. Fixture checks are not live OS inspection.")
if !failures.isEmpty { exit(1) }
